StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Resident_Evil_6
Fandom (residentevil.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://residentevil.fandom.com/wiki/Resident_Evil_6
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 2623); RAWG also keeps "Resident Evil 6: Onslaught" and "Resident Evil 6: Siege" as separate entries, but no achievement names them, so the 20 mode achievements (API ACH51 to ACH70) share one chapter described by what they mention (opponents, the Ustanak, the BSAA, agents and creatures) rather than by a guessed mode name. Steam app 221040 (schema name is the placeholder "ValveTestApp221040"); none of its 70 achievements are hidden. The four campaigns and their chapter numbers come straight from the achievement descriptions. The set-piece achievements (cathedral, VTOL, helicopter pilot, aircraft carrier) do not say which campaign they are in, so they have their own chapter. StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 0 (not marked as a stub): Prologue (about 2,800 characters), Leon Chapter 1 to 3 (about 3,800 to 4,900 each), Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are written; Leon Chapters 4 and 5 and all Chris, Jake and Ada chapters are linked but not written, so it was not used. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API with about 166 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
